speaker: Unknown
en: Tariq did us a huge favor yesterday.
zh: Tariq 昨天帮了我们一个大忙。

speaker: Unknown
en: In what ways have you been more ambitious, your prompting?
zh: 你在哪些方面更雄心了，你的提示词？

speaker: Unknown
en: For deployment, I realized that Claude Code had figured out a better deployment story with Bun.
zh: 对于部署，我意识到 Claude Code 用 Bun 想出了一个更好的部署方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was like, okay, I need to port this whole thing from Python to TypeScript.
zh: 然后我就想，好吧，我需要把这整个东西从 Python 移植到 TypeScript。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I put on my 2010s engineering hat, or even my early 20s, that's a dumb idea.
zh: 如果我戴上 2010 年代的工程师帽子，甚至 20 年代初的帽子，那是个愚蠢的想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who would ever port, at that point, a couple hundred thousands of lines of code?
zh: 谁会在那个时候去移植，几十万行代码？

speaker: Unknown
en: But I was like, I think this is doable now.
zh: 但我想，我觉得现在这是可行的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I basically created this dynamic workflow setup and over the weekend had to port the whole thing, like verify it, double check it, then read both code, like basically churn and churn and churn and then came back Monday to complete a workflow that was a ported version of that thing.
zh: 我基本上创建了这个动态工作流设置，然后在周末把整个东西移植了，比如验证它、反复检查它，然后阅读两边的代码，基本上就是不停地折腾、折腾、再折腾，然后周一回来完成了一个移植版本的工作流。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that probably ranks on like the more unreasonable things like, yeah, just port this entire Python code base to TypeScript, get it working, get it deployable in, you know, a weekend.
zh: 所以那大概算是比较不讲道理的事情之一，比如，对，就把这整个 Python 代码库移植到 TypeScript，让它跑起来，让它可以部署，你知道的，就在一个周末之内。
